falseFriends.station: Use 'stanowisko robocze' for production workstation, not 'stacja' alone (train/radio station)
falseFriends.shift: Use 'zmiana' for work shift, not 'szyfr' (cipher) or keyboard 'Shift'
falseFriends.setup: Use 'przezbrojenie' (SMED changeover) or 'naładowanie' (initial setup), not 'ustawienie' (software settings)
falseFriends.idle: Use 'bezczynny' or 'w stanie oczekiwania', not 'leniwy' (lazy — pejorative)

grammarNotes.caseSystem: Polish has 7 grammatical cases. Nominative for labels: 'Dostępność'; genitive for descriptions: 'obliczenie dostępności'
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Three genders (masculine, feminine, neuter) plus animate/inanimate distinction for masculine
grammarNotes.abstractNouns: Most OEE abstract terms end in '-ość' (feminine suffix): dostępność, wydajność, efektywność
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma. Thousands: space or period. '85,5%', '1 000 sztuk'
grammarNotes.aspectSystem: Perfective/imperfective aspects for UI buttons: 'Zapisz' (save, perfective), 'Zatwierdź' (approve, perfective)
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Singular genitive modifier is PREFERRED for manufacturing UI labels: 'przyczyny straty prędkości' (reasons + loss [gen.sg] + speed [gen.sg]). Plural genitive 'przyczyny strat prędkości' ('strat' [gen.pl]) may be governed by Polish grammar but should be treated as a soft warning, not a hard error. For automated audit purposes, treat singular genitive as correct. Flag plural genitive forms for G3 native speaker review.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE acronym is commonly used. Full Polish term: 'Całkowita Efektywność Wyposażenia' (CEW) — educational contexts only.
industryContext.germanInfluence: Strong German OEM presence (VW, Toyota, Stellantis) brings German-influenced lean terminology.

commonMistakes: Using 'aktualny' for 'actual' instead of 'rzeczywisty' — #1 cross-Slavic false friend
Incorrect case endings in technical terms — genitive, instrumental must be correct
Using informal 'ty' instead of formal 'Pan/Pani' or impersonal construction
Using 'performans' (anglicism) instead of 'wydajność' for OEE performance
Using 'stacja' for production workstation — use 'stanowisko robocze'
Dropping Polish diacritics: 'przezbrojenie' not 'przezbroenie' — diacritics mandatory

Compound plural modifier ambiguity: 'przyczyny strat prędkości' vs 'przyczyny straty prędkości' — genitive plural 'strat' vs singular 'straty'. Prefer singular modifier (names the concept); flag for G3 native speaker review
notes: OEE is commonly used; formal Pan/Pani address. Complex 7-case system. Largest manufacturing economy in Central-Eastern Europe. P95 expansion 2.17x.
